name: The Unmarked Rows
summary: Rook's Thread of Fate: the Discovery.

stages.journal: Something in Druskenvald's wider dark will show Rook how far his road runs. An Act II chapter will bring it to him.
stages.hint: Keep Rook with the party, or at camp, and rest once the chapter is done.

waits.text: Rook will want a word at camp once that chapter is behind us.

stages.journal: In the Fields of the Crow, Rook found graves nobody had ever counted, and wrote them into his ledger.
